scientific_question: Can one globally shared anchor-preserving residual improve both full-mask and signed-scribble evidence transport while exactly preserving complete observations and inactive primitive rows?

optimization.epoch_selection: lexicographic maximum of minimum per-mode AP delta, minimum per-mode fixed-IoU delta, macro AP, negative macro BCE, and negative epoch on scene0001 validation only

engineering_invariants: fully observed rows are bitwise analytic identity
inactive-domain rows are bitwise analytic identity
complement and residual-sign symmetry unit test passes
promotion_rule.scene0001_fit_gate: full-mask and scribble AP and IoU@0.5 do not regress analytic; precision delta is at least -0.01; each mode reduces absolute log area-ratio error; worst-prompt AP delta is at least -0.005
promotion_rule.scene0002_confirmation_gate: same rule evaluated exactly once without fit, selection, calibration, or threshold change
promotion_rule.target_authority: only if both clean gates and engineering invariants pass may one single-scene NVOS or SPIn sentinel be preregistered
